description: This file defines a custom JSP tag ContentImageUrlTag, which generates URLs for content images related to merchant stores within a web application. It constructs image URLs based on request context, merchant store attributes, and session configurations.

classes.name: ContentImageUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag that generates content image URLs based on the merchant store and request context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Builds and outputs the content image URL based on merchant store and session configurations.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Sets the merchant store context for the tag.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with the tag.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the image name to be used in URL construction.

methods.name: setImageType
methods.description: Sets the type of image (e.g., thumbnail, main).
